description: Retrieve aggregated game-specific statistics computed by The Blue Alliance for an event, separated into qualification and playoff phases. Includes per-task averages, scoring trends, bonus (ranking point) achievement rates, and other game-specific metrics. Field structure varies per game year (e.g., Charged Up, Crescendo, Reefscape).

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.
